protocol.observation: instrument, decision timestamp, direction and rule
protocol.scoring: Use production rule.evaluate with the saved StrategyConfig.scoring, before portfolio suppression, feasibility filtering and top-N. Record feasibility separately.
protocol.label: direction_sign * (close_at_decision_plus_horizon / decision_close - 1); an analytic opportunity label, not a claim of a fill at the signal close
protocol.excursions: Direction-adjusted high/low excursions strictly after the decision, within the fixed horizon; not truncated by a trading stop or target
protocol.eligibility: Require every future minute through the exact horizon; exclude gaps and horizons ending after the configured square-off, never carry labels overnight
protocol.primary_evaluation: Score-bucket monotonicity and rank correlation with 15-minute directional return, separately for LONG, SHORT and each rule; report sample and distinct-session counts
protocol.secondary_evaluation: 5/30-minute returns, adverse excursions, net opportunity after stated costs, score saturation and stability across sessions
protocol.uncertainty: Adjacent minutes overlap. Use session-block uncertainty and nonoverlapping-horizon sensitivity; never random-split individual rows
protocol.holdout: No score-outcome inspection or selection on Sep24-28 during tuning. Earlier aggregate backtests included Sep24/25, so this is a newly reserved tuning holdout, not pristine historical data
protocol.promotion: Persist selected parameters as a new complete strategy JSON; replay and the AI-facing scanner load the identical file and verify its fingerprint. Keep this baseline unchanged
protocol.feature_contract: One-minute regular-session candles, IST bar-open timestamps and bar-close decisions; warm from Aug31 and carry price indicators across sessions; reset session features as production does
protocol.tick_basis: NSE CMTR67133: monthly review; prior-month RELIANCE close in the >1000..5000 band implies INR0.10. This file applies only to this instrument/window
protocol.fill_status: Scenarios, not measured live fills. Minute bars cannot resolve 1s versus 10s execution. Broker and statutory fees remain charged even in the frictionless control
